title: SpeechSense: A Paralinguistic-Focused Dataset for Fine-Grained Speech Sentiment Analysis
summary: Recent advances in AI have revolutionized speech processing, yet effective speech understanding requires discerning not just what is said, but how it is said. Speech Sentiment Analysis plays a critical role in decoding these paralinguistic cues for diverse real-world applications such as recruitment and customer service.
